name: SSILVB
author: automata-rtx
description: Screen Space Indirect Lighting with Visibility Bitmask (Therrien et al. 2023): one bounce of colored indirect light gathered through a 32-sector visibility bitmask, plus a persistent world-space environment probe that lights each surface from the directions it can actually see - including from things currently off screen. Jittered temporal accumulation, edge-aware denoise, half-resolution support. Disable the bounce and it acts as directional AO with environment ambient. Requires the Depth to Normal mod.
